rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for admitting fault or referring to a minor mistake.

example.english: I really am at fault this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jau5 co3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing who bears responsibility, rather than simply saying whose fault it is.

example.english: We cannot shift the fault for this accident onto someone else.
example.traditional: 呢單意外嘅責任唔可以推畀人哋。
example.jyutping: nei1 daan1 ji3 ngoi6 ge3 zaak3 jam6 m4 ho2 ji5 teoi1 bei2 jan4 dei6

rows.note: Use this for a personal character failing or shortcoming rather than responsibility for an event.

example.english: His biggest fault is that he is too stubborn.
example.traditional: 佢最大嘅缺點係太固執。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 kyut3 dim2 hai6 taai3 gu3 zap1
